note: Subtle UI sounds, mixed low under the voice. Regenerate with: python3 demo_video/tools/sfx.py [--only id] [--force]

sounds.use: a tile lands in the drop zone
sounds.prompt: A small glass card gently landing on a soft desk: a very short airy swish followed by a soft muted tap. Clean, minimal UI sound, close-miked, no reverb tail, no music.
Gentle two-note glass chime rising softly, warm and calm, modern app success notification, very short and quiet, no music.

sounds.use: cursor clicks a tab or switch
sounds.prompt: A single soft muted trackpad click, crisp but quiet, close-miked, nothing else.
Very soft airy whoosh, subtle and smooth, like a light breeze passing, for a gentle screen transition, low volume, no music.

sounds.use: the cat stamps the verified card
sounds.prompt: A soft rubber stamp pressed onto paper on a wooden desk: one gentle muted thump, close-miked, no reverb.

sounds.use: the cat's first entrance, once only
sounds.prompt: A single short friendly house cat chirp, a soft trilled mrrp, close-miked, clean, no background noise.
